helpStartDesc.message: ClipZero runs automatically on 55 AI chat, messaging, social, developer, and webmail sites on both Firefox and Chromium.

helpStep1Desc.message: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Gmail, Outlook, WhatsApp Web, Discord, GitHub, and 47 more sites are protected out of the box.

helpStep2Desc.message: ClipZero intercepts paste, drag-and-drop, and file uploads in RAM before the page reads them—your original files on disk are never changed.

helpStep3Desc.message: Use the toolbar popup to toggle options per tab, inspect active session tokens, or open Rules & Backup for custom patterns.

helpSecretsDesc.message: Choose the right tool depending on what you want to hide when pasting or uploading text/code files:

helpSecAutoDesc.message: Enabled by default on AI chats. Detects API keys (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, AWS, GitHub), JWTs, payment cards, IBANs, URL passwords, and optional emails, phones, or IPs.

helpSecWordsDesc.message: In the popup Settings tab, list exact names, companies, or projects separated by commas (up to 50 per site). Best for fixed names without patterns.

helpSecRegexDesc.message: In Rules & Backup, pick a 1-click template or use the Guided builder (no regex knowledge needed) to hide structured codes like EMP-104298 or INC-84920 everywhere.

helpSecTokensTip.message: Tip: Masked placeholders like [REDACTED_OPENAI_KEY] stay reversible in tab RAM only. Open the popup Tokens tab to inspect or clear them, or copy a tokenized reply to get a 1-click “Restore originals” button.

helpFilesDesc.message: Cleaned losslessly in browser memory (and off-thread in a dedicated Web Worker for heavy PDF, Office, and large SVG files).

helpFmtOffice.message: Author, company, custom properties, page thumbnails, comment & track-changes authors/dates, Word rsid & local template paths, Excel local folder paths (absPath), ZIP timestamps/comments, and EXIF inside embedded photos.

helpFmtPdf.message: Document /Info author/creator fields and XMP metadata packets in-place while keeping layout, bookmarks, and xref tables intact (up to 50 MB).

helpFmtImg.message: EXIF camera/serial tags, GPS coordinates, RGB thumbnails, XMP, PNG tEXt/eXIf/C2PA/iDOT chunks, and GIF comments while keeping orientation and animation intact.

helpFmtSvgTxt.message: Strips scripts, event handlers, comments, and editor paths from SVGs; masks secrets, PII, custom words, and custom rules inside uploaded text/code files (up to 512 KB).

helpCanvasDesc.message: Enable “Redact before upload” in the popup (or press Alt+Shift+B) to inspect and censor images inside a private Shadow DOM modal before uploading.

helpToolCrop.message: Crop — trim margins with live W×H readout

helpCanvasKeysTip.message: Editor keys: Arrows / Shift+Arrows move or resize the selected box · Del removes it · Ctrl/Cmd+Z undoes · PageUp/PageDown switches batch images · Enter uploads.

helpShortcutsDesc.message: Firefox binds all 7 shortcuts automatically. Chromium allows 4 defaults; the other 3 can be assigned manually in chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

helpFaq1Q.message: Why does the ClipZero toolbar icon show an orange “!” badge?

helpFaq1A.message: That tab was already open before you installed or updated ClipZero. Because ClipZero hooks paste and upload APIs at document_start for security, simply reload that tab once (or click “Reload tab” in the popup) to activate protection.

helpFaq2Q.message: Why does Firefox ask me to grant access to supported sites?

helpFaq2A.message: In Firefox Manifest V3, host permissions can start disabled depending on browser settings. Click the “Allow” banner in the popup or Welcome page once to grant access to the 55 supported sites—ClipZero still requests zero API permissions.

helpFaq3Q.message: How do I hide custom codes if I don’t know regular expressions?

helpFaq3A.message: Open Rules & Backup and click any 1-click template (Employee ID, Ticket, Client code, Invoice, Internal token) or use the Guided builder: enter the prefix, character type, and length, test it in the live sandbox, and save.

helpFaq4Q.message: Where are my tokens and rules stored, and does anything leave my device?

helpFaq4A.message: Masked session tokens exist only in volatile tab RAM and vanish when you reload, close the tab, or click Clear vault. Your saved per-site preferences and custom rules stay in extension-isolated IndexedDB. ClipZero makes zero network calls and collects zero telemetry.

helpFaq5Q.message: Why wasn’t a legacy .doc or password-protected Office file modified?

helpFaq5A.message: ClipZero cleans modern OOXML archives (.docx, .xlsx, .pptx) losslessly. Legacy binary OLE2 files (.doc/.xls/.ppt) and encrypted documents are intentionally passed through untouched so they are never corrupted (filename anonymization still applies when enabled).
